jd:
AI GENERALIST AUTOMATION & AGENT DEVELOPMENT INTERN 
(Claude Workflows & Systems)


About Us
Interact Health PRO (IHP) develops AI-supported operational systems that help coordinate rehabilitation workflows, medical documentation, communication systems, and personal injury recovery processes.
Our organization combines healthcare coordination with AI-powered automation to improve operational efficiency, reduce repetitive administrative tasks, and support structured medical-legal workflows.


We use:

- Claude AI Skills & Routines
- Claude.md workflows
- Airtable systems
- Make.com automation
- AI-supported operational processes


Role Overview
As an AI Automation & Agent Development Intern, you will help design and implement AI-supported workflows that automate operational, administrative, and communication systems across IHP.
You will contribute to systems supporting:

- Client intake workflows
- Rehabilitation coordination
- Administrative automation
- AI-assisted communication systems
- Internal operational processes
- Workflow optimization


This role blends AI operations, automation architecture, systems thinking, and operational workflow design.
Key Responsibilities


AI Workflow Development

- Build structured Claude AI workflows for operational processes
- Support AI-enhanced automation systems
- Create repeatable workflow structures and SOPs
- Improve operational efficiency through automation


AI Agents & Operational Systems

- Develop task-based AI agents for internal support workflows
- Support automation for onboarding, communication, reporting, and tracking systems
- Assist in AI-supported administrative systems design
- Help optimize AI workflow reliability and usability


Automation Infrastructure

- Build workflow automations using Airtable and Make.com
- Create automation triggers and conditional logic structures
- Support workflow testing, debugging, and optimization
- Assist with operational documentation and workflow mapping


Cross-Team Collaboration

- Work closely with Developers, Analysts, Operations, and Project Managers
- Participate in workflow planning meetings
- Contribute ideas for AI-supported operational improvements


AI Integration
AI is the core of this role.
You will actively work with:

- Claude AI Skills & Routines
- Claude.md structured workflow systems
- AI-assisted operational automations
- Prompt engineering workflows
- Airtable automation systems
- Make.com integrations


You will help develop:

- AI-supported onboarding workflows
- AI-assisted task routing
- Intelligent communication workflows
- Operational automation systems
- Structured workflow documentation


Technical Skills

- Airtable
- Make.com
- Workflow mapping
- Process documentation
- Prompt engineering concepts
- AI-assisted productivity tools


Assets

- Automation workflow experience
- API exposure
- Systems operations knowledge
- Project coordination experience


Soft Skills & Professional Traits

- Systems-thinking mindset
- Strong organizational abilities
- Analytical and detail-oriented
- Ability to adapt quickly to new workflows
- Accountability and professionalism
- Strong communication and collaboration skills


Learning Outcomes

- Build real-world AI-supported operational systems
- Learn workflow automation architecture
- Gain hands-on experience with Claude AI workflows
- Develop automation-ready documentation skills
- Participate in startup operations and systems optimization


Why Join Us?


Become part of a 25+ IHP Intern Team and collaborate closely with Web Developers, Full Stack App Developers, AWS Engineers, Business Analysts, IT & Security Networking, Medical-Health, Social Media, Video Editors, and Administrative Groups. Together, we are launching Interact Health PRO’s innovative platforms to transform healthcare, patient outcomes, and virtual care technology.


Compensation



- We provide a high-quality learning opportunity so you make a real workplace contribution.
- We ensure you receive adequate supervision and regular guidance while giving you opportunities to learn the job.
- We provide support in developing learning objectives.
- We are prepared to participate in interviews with a Field Education Office Representative.
- We support tracking of your hours worked.
- We are prepared to complete written performance evaluations and reports required by the College or University during and at the end of the work term.
- We will provide Reference Letters upon request or accept telephone reference.
- Candidates who complete the Internship Terms are eligible to apply for part-time to full-time paid positions as they become available.
- Credits for Internship Completion (where applicable through your institution).
- We request a short “Testimonial“ of your experience and what you learned while working with IHP, to post on our website and on Google.


How to Apply


STEP 1 - Complete the IHP FALL / WINTER 2026-27 Internship SCREENING Form:
https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSeQhAmeN2_cfDZ0e4y2zxY1-RK_jMJ-kMQZImGrokGtvP02UQ/viewform


Ensure you use the same form under basic documents to upload:


STEP 2 - Your Cover Letter explaining why you are the best candidate for the Internship Program


STEP 3 - Don’t forget to upload your Resume


STEP 4 - Provide a Link to your LinkedIn profile (if you have one)


Interview Process

- Once all applications are reviewed, candidates that meet all requirements and availability will be considered.
- Candidates will be invited to join a Group Interview will be contacted via email within 48 hours after the interview.
- If selected as our preferred candidate, you will be notified within 24 hours to complete the contract agreements.


Work Environment



- All work will be done online via Zoom.
- Creative work may be used in your personal portfolio, including success stories for future opportunities (respecting confidentiality requirements).


Contact
Lucie Porter
lucie@InteractHealthPRO.com
416.303.3788
www.InteractHealthPRO.com

Gaming:
 Welcome to the world of land-based gaming. At Light & Wonder, it’s all about the games, and our Gaming team builds cutting-edge technology, products, and content for the most iconic casinos and operators across the globe.

 Position Summary 
 
 As a Software Engineer - Intern at Light & Wonder, you will join a collaborative, global engineering team that builds the technology behind our internal systems and customer-facing products. You will help maintain the automation and tools our engineers use to configure, build, package, deploy, and test software, and you will learn how a healthy software supply chain works in a real production environment.

 Essential Job Functions 
 
• Help maintain and improve build, packaging, deployment, and test automation 
• Complete small development and scripting tasks that make our tools faster and more reliable 
• Troubleshoot issues with internal systems and tools and help see them through to resolution 
• Support day-to-day technical services and operational tasks alongside your team 
• Work with engineers and peers to understand requirements, architecture, and development tools 
• Research and evaluate new technologies and share what you learn with the team 
• Document your work so others can build on it  
 Qualifications 
 
• Entry level position, some experience in a software development environment preferred 
• Currently pursuing or have completed a bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related field 
• Genuine interest in DevOps and the software supply chain 
• Clear written and verbal communication, and the ability to work well on a team. 
• Good time management and organizational skills 
• Detailed oriented and capable of working and completing tasks with supervision 
• Exposure to virtual environments, Jenkins automation, Packer/Docker, Chocolatey desired 
• Some Development abilities in C#, C++, VBScript, JavaScript, ASP.Net, HTML, Perl, awk, Python, Lua, PowerShell, Bash. 
• Experience with databases such as MS SQL Server 
• Exposure to software version control systems; GitHub, Perforce 
• This position requires 5 Days in Office 
 
 Qualifications
 Physical Requirements 
 The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to sit, stand, walk, bend, use hands, operate a computer, and have specific vision abilities to include close and distance vision, and ability to adjust focus working with computer and business equipment.
 
 Work Conditions 
 Light & Wonder and its affiliates (collectively, “L&W”) are engaged in highly regulated gaming and lottery businesses.   As a result, certain L&W employees may, among other things, be required to obtain a gaming or other license(s), undergo background investigations or security checks, or meet certain standards dictated by law, regulation or contracts.   In order to ensure L&W complies with its regulatory and contractual commitments, as a condition to hiring and continuing to employ its employees, L&W requires all of its employees to meet those requirements that are necessary to fulfill their individual roles.  As a prerequisite to employment with L&W (to the extent permitted by law), you shall be asked to consent to L&W conducting a due diligence/background investigation on you. 
 
 This job description should not be interpreted as all-inclusive; it is intended to identify major responsibilities and requirements of the job. The employee in this position may be requested to perform other job-related tasks and responsibilities than those stated above.  

 Light & Wonder is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate against applicants due to race, color, sex, age, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, status as a veteran, and basis of disability or any other federal, state or local protected class. If you’d like more information about your equal employment opportunity rights as an applicant under the law , please click here for EEOC Poster .

**This position does not offer visa transfer or sponsorship now or in the future** 

 Thank you for considering employment with Smith and Nephew. This job opportunity is not currently available for hiring; however, this requisition was established for candidates to express interest in the above position, with a view to progress formally once we are in a position to do so  

 Life Unlimited. At Smith+Nephew we design and manufacture technology that takes the limits off living. 

 The Computer Vision Software Engineer Intern will join the Software Engineering team supporting TESSA™ Spatial Surgery, Smith+Nephew’s computer-assisted solution for orthopedic surgical navigation. Working with experienced engineers, the intern will contribute to real-time computer vision and video software that helps surgeons visualize guidance and anatomical context during procedure planning and execution. 

 This role offers hands-on experience across image capture and processing, tracking, calibration, geometric computation, and overlay rendering on GPU-accelerated Linux platforms. The intern will deliver a defined, meaningful project, learn how software is developed and verified in a regulated medical-device environment, and gain exposure to the impact of navigation technology in arthroscopy. A hybrid schedule is anticipated to enable regular work with development and test hardware. 

 What will you be doing? 

• Work with experienced mentors to define and complete a focused internship project with a measurable outcome for Smith+Nephew’s navigation software. 
• Develop, test, and maintain computer vision features for real-time surgical navigation, including image processing, augmented-reality overlays, and geometric computations. 
• Use MATLAB, Python, Julia, or similar tools where appropriate to prototype algorithms, analyze data, or create validation scripts. 
• Participate in code reviews, technical documentation, and agile team practices using Git, GitLab, CI, and standardized or containerized development environments. 
• Collaborate effectively with colleagues across different locations and time zones. 
• Develop C++ skills while learning and applying medical-software practices related to quality, traceability, risk awareness, and verification under the mentorship of experienced engineers. 
• Document the project, its results, and key learnings, and present the outcome to engineering stakeholders and senior leadership. 
 Planned Start Date: May 2027 
 Program Length: 12 weeks 
 Location: Andover, MA 

 What will you need to be successful 

 Education : 
 
• Currently enrolled in an accredited Bachelor’s or Master’s program in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, Software Engineering, or a closely related field. 
• Candidates at approximately the third year of undergraduate study or beyond are encouraged to apply; equivalent project-based experience will also be considered. 
• Must be in good academic standing, with a 3.0 minimum GPA preferred. 
 Experience: 

• Demonstrated programming experience through coursework, academic or personal projects, a prior internship, co-op, part-time role, apprenticeship, or research. 
• Programming experience in MATLAB, Python, Julia, C++, or another language through coursework or projects. Previous exposure to C++ is an advantage, but it is not required. 
• Coursework or project exposure to computer vision or image processing, such as camera models, image filtering, feature detection, multi-view geometry, tracking, or camera calibration 
• Working knowledge of linear algebra and 3D geometry, including rotations, rigid transforms, and projection. 
• Exposure to computer vision libraries or software build tools, such as OpenCV or CMake, is a plus. 
• Exposure to NVIDIA Jetson, CUDA, Holoscan, or similar GPU or streaming platforms is a plus. 
• Familiarity with Eigen, Ceres, optimization methods, point clouds, registration, video pipelines, tracking, or augmented-reality overlays is a plus. 
 Competencies: 

• Strong interest in computer vision, medical technology, robotics, augmented reality, or real-time embedded systems. 
• Curiosity about surgical navigation and enthusiasm for understanding how software can support arthroscopy workflows and patient care. 
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a practical and methodical approach to experimentation and debugging. 
• Ability to design, implement, test, and clearly document software solutions with guidance from experienced engineers. 
• Clear written and verbal communication and the ability to collaborate with geographically distributed teams. 
• Ability to work independently on defined tasks while seeking feedback and contributing effectively as part of a team. 
• High learning agility and motivation to turn academic knowledge into an impactful engineering contribution. 

 You. Unlimited 

 We believe in creating the greatest good for society. Our strongest investments are in our people and the patients we serve. 
 Inclusion and Belonging- Committed to Welcoming, Celebrating, and Thriving. Learn more about Employee Inclusion Groups on our website 

 Other reasons why you will love it here! 

 Training: Hands-On, Team-Customized, Mentorship 

 The anticipated base compensation range for this position is $27- $32 USD hourly
 The actual base pay offered to the successful candidate will be based on multiple factors, including but not limited to job-related knowledge/skills, experience, geographical location, and internal equity. It is not typical for an individual to be hired at the high end of the range for their role at Smith + Nephew. role: Technology Product Development Developer Intern- Summer 2027
jd:
Why Stifel

 Stifel strives for a culture that puts its clients and associates first: a culture where everyone belongs, everyone is welcome, and everyone contributes to the success of our clients, their careers, and the firm as a whole.

 Let’s talk about how you can find your place here at Stifel,  where success meets success .

 What You'll Be Doing

 Stifel's Technology Product Development department works to transform our digital technology for advisors in order to strengthen client bonds. The Technology Product Developer Intern will Assist the Development team in various phases of development, including design, implementation, integration, revision control, release and the maintenance of multiple products and systems.

 What We're Looking For

• Assist the Development team in various phases of development and with the maintenance of multiple products and systems. 
 
• Implement short-cycle development tasks. 
 
• Develop understanding of unit testing and continuous integration practices. 
 
• Work closely with Development team to understand and follow Stifel's coding and core development concepts. 
 
• Document clearly and effectively within code. 
 
• Learn from and participate with more experienced developers for complex developmental tasks. 
 
 What You'll Bring

• Ability to collaborate with a team using knowledge of appropriate development environments. 
 
• Ability to resolve problems, basic troubleshooting and problem-solving skills. 
 
• Displays awareness of the impact of actions on the product or feature and acts in line with it. 
 
 Education & Experience

• Pursuing a degree in computer science and/or software development with at least one year of college completed preferred. 
 
 Systems & Technology

• Experience in C#/.NET, or relevant Java/C++ or equivalent relational database systems. 
 
• Experience with JavaScript Libraries/Frameworks (Angular, jQuery). 
 
• Proficient in Microsoft Excel, Word, and Outlook. 
 
 About Stifel

 Stifel is more than 130 years old and still thinking like a start-up.  We are a global wealth management and investment banking firm serious about innovation and fresh ideas.  Built on a simple premise of safeguarding our clients’ money as if it were our own, coined by our namesake, Herman Stifel, our success is intimately tied to our commitment to helping families, companies, and municipalities find their own success.

 While our headquarters is in St. Louis, we have offices in New York, San Francisco, Baltimore, London, Frankfurt, Toronto, and more than 400 other locations.  Stifel is home to approximately 9,000 individuals who are currently building their careers as financial advisors, research analysts, project managers, marketing specialists, developers, bankers, operations associates, among hundreds more.  Let’s talk about how you can find your place here at Stifel, where success meets success.

 At Stifel we offer an entrepreneurial environment, comprehensive benefits package to include health, dental and vision care, 401k, wellness initiatives, life insurance, and paid time off.

 Stifel is an Equal Opportunity Employer.
fit_why: Web dev internship; C#/.NET preferred, Java/JS/SQL overlap

role: Summer 2027 - Software Engineering Intern - Lehigh Valley - PA
jd:
Overview

 Lutron is seeking an Software Engineering Intern to join our collaborative team and contribute to high-impact projects. In this role, you will help design and deliver software driven solutions that power smart lighting and shading systems. At Lutron, your interest in application software development will grow through hands-on experience, practical skill-building, and collaboration with experienced application software engineers in a supportive environment. 

 We consider interns to be very valuable in our search for exceptional future members of our team and pride ourselves in providing outstanding work experience to students from a wide variety of universities and backgrounds.

 Responsibilities

 Your internship at Lutron could offer you the opportunity to work on: 

• Software design, development, and testing 

• Code reviews and technical discussions 

• Software debugging, testing and tracing 

• Driving active projects in partnership with cross functional teams 

• Learning and applying newly adopted tools and technologies to enhance system performance, reliability, and scalability 

 Qualifications

 We seek talented, success-minded people with the desire and ability to make things happen. Our baseline requirements are simple: 

• You are pursuing a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or Software Engineering 

• Your cumulative GPA is at least 3.20 

• You are a rising junior, rising senior, or master's student at the start of the internship

• You have broad interests in application software, design and development 

• You are authorized to work in the U.S. and will not require Lutron to sponsor you for any work visa, such as an H-1B, either immediately or at any time in the future. Lutron does not offer work visa sponsorship for this position. 

• Willing and available to work on-site 5 days per week 

 Lutron is a team-oriented environment, and you will work within these teams to look at broad issues and identify root causes, not just quick fixes. You must have a willingness to ask tough questions, seek out new resources and work hard to find the best solution. 

 Here is what you can expect from our internship program: 

• Competitive pay 

• Housing resources 

• Meaningful project-based work 

• Mentorship 

• Experiential learning 

• Shadowing opportunities 

• Collaborative, cross-functional teams 

• Networking opportunities 

• Social events 

 Lutron Electronics’ position as the worldwide leader in innovative lighting control and shading solutions has enabled consistent, annual growth. Our company has cultivated a reputation of unsurpassed quality, a broad range of technologies and product offerings, and a strong commitment to servicing our worldwide customers. This has allowed the company to invest in developing new technologies and services, expand our technical capabilities and global presence, and to find and retain the best talent.  Build your career with Lutron where you will enjoy competitive compensation and benefits while exploring many options for continued growth and education. Make a difference every day in our dynamic, people-centric, technology-driven organization. For more information, view our website at  www.lutron.com. 

 Lutron Electronics is an Equal Opportunity – Affirmative Action – Employer. We welcome qualified, motivated applicants regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability or genetics
